input.command: S="--session task-hr1"; agent-browser $S open https://www.hockey-reference.com/leagues/NHL_2017.html; agent-browser $S eval 'const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll("table[id^=standings] tbody tr, table#stats tbody tr")];const out=[];for(const r of rows){const t=r.querySelector("[data-stat=team_name]"),gf=r.querySelector("[data-stat=goals]"),ga=r.querySelector("[data-stat=opp_goals]");if(t&&gf&&ga&&!r.classList.contains("thead"))out.push([t.innerText,gf.innerText-ga.innerText]);}JSON.stringify({ids:[...document.querySelectorAll("table")].map(t=>t.id),out:out.sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).slice(0,4)})'
